text:
evan: quick notice, a customer sent ~900 mixed-dim embed requests (512/768/1024) in one POST. ingress queues spiked for ~40s.
neha: yikes. any 413s or split failures?
evan: a handful of 413s from the splitter once framed payload exceeded max_bytes. most connections stayed open and continuous batching held them, causing P99 increase.
taryn: can we do cheap preflight at LB to estimate 'embed-units' and warn/reject early? Avoid holding batching windows.
eha: yes. proposal: /embeds/preflight or an ingress fast-check that uses headers: `X-Embed-Dims: 512,768,...` + `Content-Length` (or compressed bytes) -> return estimated_units and suggested_chunk_size. Example response: `{"estimated_units":"420","suggested_chunk":"100"}`
console-pm: from Console side we should show that estimate before submit, and offer a one-click "auto-chunk with SDK" option. Users seeing a big number should get an inline recommendation.
taryn: runtime behavior: three phased rollout. 1) metrics-only emit `preflight.estimated_units` and `ingress.heavy_flag`. 2) soft-reject (4xx + suggest header `X-Embed-Suggest-Chunks`) for opt-in tenants. 3) global fast-reject for oversize.
eha: for soft-reject prefer 429 with JSON error and header `X-Embed-Suggest-Chunks: 100`. 429 signals client-side retry intent vs 413 which looks opaque today.
eha: telemetry fields: `preflight.estimated_units`, `ingress.heavy_flag`, `reject.code`, `suggested_chunk`, `sdk.autochunk_used:true|false`. Keep cardinality low.
console-pm: will add UI modal copy: "Large mixed-dimension requests increase latency and cost. Recommended chunk size: N. Try SDK auto-chunking or streaming embeddings." Link to examples.
taryn: SDK: add `X-Embed-Client-Chunked: true` header on retries so we can measure conversion and post-retry success rate.
evan: tests: add e2e with gzip framing variations and mixed dims. Also add unit for preflight estimator math (dim weighting + compressed bytes -> units).
ops-bot: deploy queued: embeds-preflight-check v0.1 -> staging (sha: b7c8d9).
eha: rollout timeline: 2w metrics-only, 1w opt-in SDK experiment (autochunk), 5% soft-reject canary, then global. Tagging @eng-oncall to monitor SLO and retry funnel. :eyes:
